text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty auto-page PD-12345 -> metrics-ingest.prom-scrape FAIL (eu-west-1). 3 targets failing  -> unacked pages.

pagerbot: PD-12345 auto-escalated to level-2 after 2 mins without ack.

alex: acked. I'm on it, pulling dashboards (eu-west-1).

maya: seeing scrape_error_rate spike from 0.2% -> 12% on prometheus-exporters. also kafka log-ingest consumer lag increasing. link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/metrics/ingest?orgId=1

samir: looks like backend S3 writes are 429ing, logs show repeated 503/timeouts from s3-proxy. might be client-side throttling. grabbing runbook. runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/log-ingest-backpressure

alex: quick check: 
```kubectl -n metrics get deploy prometheus-exporter -o wide
kubectl -n metrics logs deploy/prometheus-exporter --tail=50
```
logs-bot: tail shows repeated `PutObject` errors: "RequestTimeout" and "SlowDown".

maya: confirmed, exporter pods are spiking CPU and retrying uploads -> increasing backoff. downstream kafka backlog at ~120k messages. customer impact: ingestion delays for recent logs, alerting/metrics may be missing for some customers (likely high-ingestion customers).

alex: mitigation plan: 1) suppress noisy scrape alerts for 10m to reduce paging, 2) scale exporter deployment to +2 replicas, 3) restart exporter pods one-at-a-time, 4) open temporary write route to backup S3 endpoint (eu-west-2) if available.

samir: agree. I'll open PD escalation to infra (PD-12346) if scaling doesn't recover. temporarily increasing max concurrent uploads per exporter to reduce retries. patch ready, rolling deploy if green.

customer-ops: prepping customer advisory draft. which tenants hit hardest? maya, can you paste top 5 tenant IDs?

maya: top tenants: tenant_42, tenant_9, tenant_bigco, tenant_omega, tenant_testinc. ETA on mitigation ~ 8-12 mins if restarts succeed.

alex: executing: suppressing rule prom-scrape-error (scope: eu-west-1) for 10m :gear:
pagerbot: suppression applied by alex for 10 minutes.

alex: scaling prometheus-exporter to 5 replicas -> `kubectl scale deploy prometheus-exporter --replicas=5 -n metrics`
logs-bot: scaling triggered, new pods initializing.

samir: applying config change to reduce concurrent uploads from 50 -> 20 to avoid hammering S3, patch: `configs/ingest/limited-concurrency.yml` then rolling restart.

maya: kafka consumer lag starting to drop (120k -> 55k) after first exporter restarted. nice.

incident-bot: PD-12345 acknowledged by alex.

alex: rolling restart complete, CPU settled, error rates dropping to ~1.8%.

customer-ops: draft ready, sending targeted note to tenant_bigco and tenant_omega now (no wide blast).

samir: S3 metrics show reduced 503s post-config change. keeping extra replicas for 20m then revert.

maya: confirm: no missing critical metrics observed in last 5m. still monitoring.

alex: handing off to next oncall for watch-and-watchlist: @oncall-rotations. leaving notes: suppressed alerts, replicas scaled to 5, concurrency reduced, PD ticket linked PD-12345. if error rate creeps >5% re-open escalation.

oncall-rotations: acked handoff. will monitor and update if any regressions.

customer-ops: sent updates to affected tenants, flagged for follow-up post-mitigation.

samir: will open a follow-up changelog + postmortem stub in 30m. assigning to eng-ml to check long-term retry/backoff heuristics.

alex: closing thread here, leaving open until metrics stable for 30m. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: PD-12345 auto-closed (resolved) after ack + mitigation.

logs-bot: final note: archived logs and attached diagnostic bundle to PD ticket.

oncall-rotations: last check 1749999000 - all green in eu-west-1, kafka lag down to normal. will keep an eye.
